item.text: Both spoons are at the same room temperature, but metal conducts heat much better than wood. When you touch the metal spoon, heat quickly flows from your warmer hand into the spoon, cooling your skin fast. Your nerves interpret that rapid heat loss as “cold.” Wood is a poor conductor, so it draws heat from your hand slowly and feels warmer—even though it is actually the same temperature as the metal spoon.
